lines.text: 清洗与平坦化：管理表面和地形
lines.zh: 清洗与平坦化：管理表面和地形
lines.en: Cleaning and planarization: manage surfaces and topography
Particles, metal, residue, surface state and planarity

lines.text: 清洗 | 控制污染与表面状态
lines.zh: 清洗 | 控制污染与表面状态
lines.en: Cleaning: control contamination and surface condition
Multiple contaminants exist on the surface

lines.text: CMP |优先去除高处实现平坦化
lines.zh: CMP |优先去除高处实现平坦化
lines.en: CMP: preferentially remove high regions to planarize

lines.text: CMP负责去除高处，不负责填充低处；低处填充发生在前序沉积。
lines.zh: CMP负责去除高处，不负责填充低处；低处填充发生在前序沉积。
lines.en: CMP removes high regions; it does not fill low regions, which are filled during preceding deposition

lines.text: 前序Fill质量 决定CMP余量
lines.zh: 前序Fill质量 → 决定CMP余量
lines.en: Previous fill quality → determines CMP margin

lines.text: 量测反馈：Defect Map / Thickness / Topography / Surface Analysis
lines.zh: 量测反馈：Defect Map / Thickness / Topography / Surface Analysis
lines.en: Metrology feedback: defect map / thickness / topography / surface analysis

lines.text: Adhesion / Lithography Focus / Overlay / Contact R / Yield
lines.zh: Adhesion / Lithography Focus / Overlay / Contact R / Yield
lines.en: Adhesion / lithography focus / overlay / contact resistance / yield

lines.text: 清洗化学、Slurry、Pad 与Endpoint策略会随材料体系、结构和Fab政策变化。
lines.zh: 清洗化学、Slurry、Pad 与Endpoint策略会随材料体系、结构和Fab政策变化。
lines.en: Cleaning chemistry, slurry, pad and endpoint strategies vary with materials, structures and fab policy
